description.en: A microSD memory card, 15 × 11 × 1.0 mm, with eight contact pads at its narrower end and a stepped notch on one long side. It goes into a card slot contact end first.
description.es: Una tarjeta de memoria microSD, de 15 × 11 × 1.0 mm, con ocho contactos en su extremo más angosto y una muesca escalonada en un lado largo. Entra en una ranura por el extremo de los contactos.
description.fr: Une carte mémoire microSD, de 15 × 11 × 1,0 mm, avec huit plages de contact à son extrémité la plus étroite et une encoche en gradin sur un grand côté. Elle entre dans une fente par l'extrémité des contacts.
description.pt: Um cartão de memória microSD, de 15 × 11 × 1,0 mm, com oito contatos na extremidade mais estreita e um entalhe escalonado num lado longo. Entra numa ranhura pela extremidade dos contatos.

governing.designation: SD Association microSD Memory Card form factor

sources.title: Kingston microSDHC memory card (SDCIT, 8–32 GB) specification sheet, document 4900180-001.A00
sources.supports: appendix, microSD mechanical dimensions: 15.00 ±0.1 long, 11.00 ±0.1 wide, 1.00 ±0.1 thick (0.70 ±0.1 over the contact area); the contact end narrows to 9.70 ±0.1, flush with one long side, with the step on the other; eight contact pads; weight 0.5 g typical; no mechanical write-protect switch

frame_convention: Origin on the contact (leading) end's line, at the middle of the card's 11 mm width, on the plane of the contact face. +z points out of the contact face; +y points from the rear end toward the contact end, so the card occupies y from −15 to 0 and z from −1.0 to 0. +x points across the width toward the long side the narrow contact end is flush with; the stepped notch is on the −x side (Kingston appendix, contact-side view).

interfaces.note: Male: the card goes into a slot contact end first; the frame sits on the contact end's line at the middle of the width, mid-thickness, its normal along the insertion direction. Symmetry 1: the outline is not symmetric.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The SD Association's physical specification is distributed behind a click-through licence, so the numbers cite two card makers' datasheets; they agree on the outline. The notch's own dimensions are drawn by Kingston but not stated here.

solids.note: the card at its nominal size

envelope.note: A box at the nominal length, width and thickness; the narrow contact end, the notch and the thinner contact area are not modelled.
